title: Restore per-Buddy-DM model selector
summary: Owner asked where the Buddy DM header model selector went and requested it back. Product Development Lead replied that moving Buddy DMs into Channels had left the old conversation-header selector behind, and restored a per-DM picker for desktop and mobile. It changes that DM's model for the next turn; Buddy defaults for new conversations remain under Buddy → Settings. The implementation commit is present on main. A related Buddy header task is done. No separate task specifically tracks this request. Closure is supported for the exact feature ask; live release/runtime verification was not independently established in this audit.
nextAction: None for the exact request: the per-DM model picker was restored and committed. The linked header task is done. Runtime/release visibility was not independently checked.
evidence: Thread reply post_01a0e229-1f9c-72d8-ba4e-67aceb321ce3 states picker restored on desktop and mobile; applies to next turn; Buddy default remains in Buddy → Settings; reports typecheck and formatting pass, client suite 190/191 with unrelated failure, and invariant gate concurrent CSS failure.

Commit 8dcc7e58c685925d76ecb7fdbc7b4481f667fbb3 ('Restore model picker in Buddy DM header') is contained in main; git show confirms ChannelDm.tsx adds modelSummary button and ConfigOverlay wired to setConversationConfig.
